data.title: Subitizing Numbers to 10
data.description: Practice recognizing quantities quickly on a ten frame using flash subitizing.

challenges.hint: Look quickly at the top row. How many dots did you see?
challenges.narration: Get ready to flash and tell me how many red counters you see!
challenges.instruction: How many counters did you see?

challenges.hint: Try to see the group all at once without counting one by one.
challenges.narration: Here comes another flash. How many are there?
challenges.instruction: How many counters did you see?

challenges.hint: Notice how many spaces are left empty in the top row.
challenges.narration: Watch closely and catch the number!
challenges.instruction: How many counters did you see?

challenges.hint: A full top row always means five!
challenges.narration: A whole row just flashed! How many?
challenges.instruction: How many counters did you see?

challenges.hint: Five on top and one more on the bottom row.
challenges.narration: Keep your eyes open for this quick flash.
challenges.instruction: How many counters did you see?

challenges.hint: Look at the empty spaces to help you figure it out.
challenges.narration: Almost a full frame! How many did you see?
challenges.instruction: How many counters did you see?

challenges.hint: A completely full ten frame is always ten!
challenges.narration: The final flash! Tell me the total number.
challenges.instruction: How many counters did you see?
